payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image visibly fulfill the request to turn the image into a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Using only the support findings, mark complete if the image as a whole is rendered as a chalk-made drawing. Mark partial if there is evidence of some chalk-drawing progress but the whole-image transformation is incomplete. Mark absent if there is sufficient evidence of no requested chalk-drawing progress; unrelated edits alone are absent. Mark unknown when required evidence is insufficient or unresolved. A failed check does not by itself mean absent if another check establishes partial progress; unknown evidence remains unresolved.
node.binding: Target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.. Reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing..
